summary: The protection score now gives credit for every fix, and its formula is shown next to it.

new.title: The protection score gives credit for every fix
new.text: Each asset has a health of 0-100: Very High -25, High -10, Medium and Low together at most -20. Tiers count with fixed shares: Tier 0 40 %, Tier 1 30 %, Tier 2 20 %, Tier 3 10 %.

new.title: The formula next to every protection score
new.text: The formula, with your own settings, is shown next to every protection score on the Executive overview, the Executive report and the wall board.

fixes.title: Application columns right after the task
fixes.text: On Remediation tasks, Application, Application version, Paths and Detected paths sit right after the task, also in saved layouts.

fixes.title: Support access closes when it should
fixes.text: A request to close support access always goes through, also when several requests wait at once.

fixes.title: The update shows its progress
fixes.text: A long refresh of the pages' data during an update says how far it has come, and a finished update is no longer reported as stopped.

fixes.title: Summary groups keep one spelling
fixes.text: A value spelled two ways (User and user) is one group, so the history check no longer reports false differences.
